verdict.rationale: Thoropass ships a built-in AI Helpbot, opened with cmd/ctrl+K, but it is documented only as answering questions from support and documentation content. Built-in AI features do carry out specific tasks: First Pass AI pre-screens evidence and GenAI DDQ autofills questionnaires. The MCP server lets an external assistant act in the workspace, so it is not a built-in assistant and is not credited here. Missing for 10: an in-product assistant that takes general delegated actions (creating or updating controls, evidence or tasks), multi-step agentic execution from the built-in assistant, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product

citations.quote: The AI Helpbot is designed to assist users by answering questions based on approved Thoropass support and documentation content.
You can also open the bot with a cmd/ctrl + K keyboard shortcut!
First Pass AI pre-screens evidence before the audit, eliminating the bottlenecks between evidence collection and auditor acceptance
How to Use the Autofill Automation for Questionnaires
